rumor.content: Exact plain UTF-8 text, never a JSON commerce record
rumor.recipient_set: Sorted unique author and peer; one exact rumor for every per-recipient seal, including a deduplicated self-conversation
rumor.authorization: Codec descriptors verify no source, parent, history, grant, consent, route or participant authority

canonical.preimage: NIP-01 [0,pubkey,created_at,kind,tags,content], exact tag order and Unicode, lowercase control escapes, no Unicode normalization
canonical.legacy: Event wire-v1 delegates canonical serialization while retaining its full accepted u64 timestamp/u32 kind range and public parse/error behavior
canonical.private_buffers: Bound complete serialization before copying; clear owned rumor and temporary preimage text; no payload-bearing automatic diagnostics
canonical.unsigned_json: Exact id/pubkey/created_at/kind/tags/content with no signature; complete unsigned length equals canonical preimage length plus 116 bytes
canonical.signed_json_length: The supported exact complete signed object length equals canonical preimage length plus 253 bytes

seal.timestamp: Explicit positive time no later than rumor time and at most 172800 seconds earlier; runtime supplies checked randomized input
seal.ciphertext: Canonical base64 shape, version-2 prefix, exact predicted padded payload size; structural checks do not authenticate a MAC
seal.signing: Convert validated known-kind fields through the existing exact-intent signer; no command or durable-admission authority is created

nested_budget.profile: Size calculations cover the standard two-byte NIP-44 v2 length prefix for lengths 1 through 65535; no extended-prefix support is claimed.
nested_budget.provider_caps: A size calculation does not advertise encryption capability for every counted input. Both selected chat layers must fit the concrete provider's 65536-byte text/ciphertext boundary and the complete signed-event bounds.
nested_budget.measurement: Before business seal signing, count complete rumor, padded/base64 rumor ciphertext, worst supported-timestamp signed seal, padded/base64 outer ciphertext and complete signed 1059 envelope
nested_budget.qualification: Independent ECMAScript JSON/SHA-256/base64 vectors plus actual Rust encryption/signature/decryption conversion; structural vectors deliberately carry no valid MAC

remaining: Actual native T1 commit of complete plans, authenticated current access and advertised routes, issuance attempt ownership, obtained evidence capture, install/outbox, exact per-recipient wrapping/delivery, full receipts, browser/bindings and final acceptance
